fato_historico: 2002: A federal grand jury in Houston, Texas indicts former Enron chief financial officer Andrew Fastow on 78 counts of wire fraud, money laundering, conspiracy and obstruction of justice related to the collapse of his ex-employer.
energia_do_dia: Today brings an invitation to embrace transparency and personal truth. Much like life requires clearing away shadows to find lasting stability, it is a good time to evaluate your foundations. Consider releasing outdated burdens that no longer serve your growth, allowing your natural Leo brilliance to guide you toward more honest and authentic connections with everyone around you.
frase_do_dia: True light reveals the path when we choose to walk with an honest heart.
significado_numero: The number of deep introspection and unlocking inner wisdom.
conselho: Focus on clear communication and honor your values in every interaction today.
